d: Eden Rose is currently engaged with a banking institution within Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) who are seeking a Regulatory Compliance Associate to support the regulatory compliance and financial crime compliance framework as a second line of defence function.
Reporting to the Head of Compliance and MLRO this role requires 50% Regulatory Compliance experience and 50% Financial Crime Compliance (AML/CFT/Sanctions/KYC).
r: Support implementation and maintenance of the Bank's Regulatory Compliance Framework.
Provide compliance guidance for business, operations and support functions on applicable FSRA regulations and regulatory obligations
Assist with regulatory impact assessments arising from new or amended FSRA, ADGM and UAE regulations
Monitor developments issued by FSRA, ADGM, UAE AML Executive Office, UAE Financial Intelligence Unit, Relevant international standard setters and regulators
Maintain regulatory change logs and coordinate implementation of required actions.
Support policy and procedure enhancements resulting from regulatory developments.
Review customer onboarding, periodic review and event-driven review cases.
Review name screening alerts generated through onboarding and transaction systems.
Assist the MLRO in gathering information relating to suspicious activity investigations.
The Regulatory Compliance Associate will hold a Bachelor’s degree in law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management or related discipline.

Professional qualifications such as ICA Diploma in Compliance or ACAMS Certification, or any equivalent regulatory or compliance certification is preferred. You will have a minimum 5-8 years of experience within banking, financial services, fintech, or regulated financial institutions. You will have experience in both Regulatory Compliance and Financial Crime Compliance and experience working within organizations regulated by FSRA, DFSA, CBUAE or other recognized financial regulators. Experience dealing with corporate, institutional and high-risk clients.
This is an excellent opportunity with a growing financial institution. Please apply now or for further information contact Kayte Short at Eden Rose at Kayte.short@edenrose.ae

d: Turn clicks into connections. Products into possibilities. Data into growth.
Are you passionate about e-commerce, obsessed with the details, and always looking for ways to make the online shopping experience better?

At Boutiqaat, we’re looking for a Senior Merchandising Specialist who knows that great online merchandising is more than just placing products on a page. It’s about creating seamless shopping journeys, driving product performance, maximizing visibility, and turning customer insights into commercial success.
q: Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, E-Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
5–7 years of experience in e-commerce merchandising, digital merchandising, e-commerce operations, or category management.
Strong expertise in product and category merchandising, campaign execution, promotions, and digital optimization.
Advanced knowledge of e-commerce platforms, CMS, PIM, and merchandising systems.
Strong analytical skills and experience with Google Analytics / GA4.
Excellent understanding of promotional mechanics, customer behavior, and e-commerce performance.
A sharp eye for detail, a problem-solving mindset, and the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Fluent in English; Arabic is a plus.

At Boutiqaat, you won’t just join a company you’ll join a movement redefining e-commerce beauty and lifestyle retail. Here, every day offers new challenges, learning opportunities, and a chance to help build a smarter, more efficient operation from the ground up.
Kickstart your career with hands-on experience, expert mentorship, and real impact. Apply now and be part of something exciting!
r: Own the Digital Shelf: Manage and optimize product categories, placements, sorting, navigation, and product visibility to create an engaging shopping experience.
Make Campaigns Happen: Bring promotions, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and exciting offers to life with flawless execution.
Turn Data into Action: Analyze product, category, and campaign performance to uncover opportunities, improve conversion, and drive growth.
Master the Merchandising Engine: Manage backend configurations, promotional mechanics, system enhancements, and UAT activities to keep everything running smoothly.
Enhance the Customer Journey: Ensure product content, images, categorization, and digital touchpoints are accurate, relevant, and customer friendly.
Connect & Collaborate: Work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver merchandising initiatives, solve challenges, and turn ideas into results.
